_doc: Route scoring windows as data. A route is found by the sha1 (first 12) of the script as run, or by file name. Times are app-clock seconds; a script mark (wait_met / wait_skipped / script_end line=N at=T) is on the script clock, so the scorer adds EDEN_GUEST_START. A 5 s fps line is stamped at the END of its 5 seconds. Definitions transcribed from runs/Vampinity/2026-11-15-t186-control-README.md (Vampinity) and our kokiri-four-stops README; to be confirmed by their owners. A window is placed only by lines that were MET: a line logged as wait_skipped (a MAYBE that timed out) gives the window no value and makes the start INVALID (PR #18 review, 18 Nov), unless the window says "clock_marks": true - its lines are short MAYBEs written to time out, used only as a clock (the Kokiri stands).
